title: Corpse Carnival
overview: CHARLIE, a timid boy with a crippling stutter, is locked in the basement by his abusive stepdad DAVE. There Charlie meets two talking corpses, TONY and BUTCH. These decaying, foul-mouthed, yet oddly kind cadavers will teach Charlie, through comedy and laughter, to find confidence, self-assurance, and the courage he needs to call 911 despite his stutter and get the help he needs. This will also help themselves to be found and give peace of mind to their loved ones by finally getting a burial.
